Body.Content:
Scheduling teams planning multiday work do so using the aggregate views on the schedule board - the daily, weekly, and monthly views. On those views, multiple bookings are aggregated into a single object that spans the entire period.

This improvement will allow administrators to configure the template and tooltips that are available on those views, so they can display information relevant to their dispatchers Custom html templates will bind to the requirement, rather than the booking, allowing fields common to the entire aggregation to be displayed. Tooltips will allow paging through each booking in the aggregation, so each can be viewed without needing to navigate to the underlying record.

GA date: April CY2027
